messages:
Tyler (Product Ops): Morning — final sweep for GA greenlight. Quick checklist: SLA wording, docs, oncall rota, monitoring alerts, pricing page. Who's owning gaps?
Maya (PM): I can own SLA wording + acceptance criteria. Need Legal signoff though.
Sam (EngLead): Eng will confirm latency P99 targets and quota enforcement. I have one question on fallback behavior for overloaded Dedicated pools.
Jamie (SRE): Oncall rota is almost ready. Need one more escalation playbook item for model-fallbacks. Also scheduling a smoke run tomorrow at 07:00 UTC.
Priya (Docs): Docs draft is >80% — missing the troubleshooting runbook and sample `curl` + SDK call flow. Can we get a short code snippet from eng?
Sam (EngLead): Yup — will paste a minimal SDK + curl example in this thread by EOD.
Alex (Finance): Pricing page: need final approved per-token numbers and burst policy wording. Also confirm whether pilot customers get reduced committed rates.
Maya (PM): Pilot concession: yes, we can offer a 10% discount for first 3 months — but we need billing to codify it as a promo code. Alex, can you own?
Alex (Finance): I can own promo code setup. Will coordinate with billing. Need final SKU names.
Tyler (Product Ops): Great. Risks: 1) Monitoring alert noise for KV-cache misses, 2) unclear SLA reparations language, 3) documents missing precise rollback steps. Short owner list please.
Jamie (SRE): I’ll take monitoring alert tuning. Plan: mute noisy alerts during ramp, add a staged alert severity map.
Maya (PM): I’ll take SLA reparations wording + PO signoff, loop Legal.
Priya (Docs): I’ll author rollback steps but need a bulleted runbook from Eng + SRE (5-7 steps).
Sam (EngLead): Will write the 5-step rollback and paste here. Quick draft:
```
1) Switch routing policy to fallback-model (10s window)
2) Drain new requests from affected pool
3) Scale up Dedicated capacity by +1 node (auto or manual)
4) Clear KV cache if it's corrupted (see infra playbook)
5) Re-run smoke tests and promote when P50/P95 back to baseline
```
Priya (Docs): Perfect, thanks. I'll integrate that and add `curl` examples.
DeployBot: Deploy scheduled to prod at 2026-03-25T07:00:00Z by @sam. CI checks: unit=pass, e2e=pass, perf=running.
Sam (EngLead): Note: perf job still running; if it flaps, we will delay by 1h.
Jamie (SRE): Smoke run tomorrow will exercise fallback-model route and oncall paging. Everyone invited.
Tyler (Product Ops): Two open asks before greenlight: - Legal approval on SLA reparations (Maya) - Final pricing SKUs + promo code (Alex). Can we close both by EOD?
Maya (PM): I'll ping Legal — expecting response within 4 hours.
Alex (Finance): Billing side needs SKU mapping from Product (Maya) and confirm promo quota. I'll aim for EOD.
Priya (Docs): ETA for final docs merge? If code snippets and rollback steps in, I can ship a docs PR by 18:00 UTC.
Sam (EngLead): I'll paste the `curl` + SDK minimal examples now:
```
# curl example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-instruct-v1","input":"Summarize...","max_tokens":200}'

# python SDK example
from redwood import Redwood
r = Redwood(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = r.generate(model="redwood-instruct-v1", input="Summarize...")
print(resp.text)
```
Priya (Docs): Thanks — I’ll format and add snippets to the quickstart page.
Jamie (SRE): One more infra note: add a tagging rule so we can route high-cost customer requests to dedicated billing bucket. Alex, want to confirm billing tag mapping?
Alex (Finance): Yes, confirm tag names and I'll wire them into cost reports.
Tyler (Product Ops): Thanks team. If Legal + Billing close by EOD and perf job is green, we proceed with the deploy tomorrow. Call out any blockers now.
Maya (PM): No blockers from product beyond Legal ping.
Sam (EngLead): Perf job still running; will update in 20m.
Jamie (SRE): Preparing alert suppression plan. Will share a short doc link when ready.
Alex (Finance): I'll post SKU + promo code notes in this thread when ready.
Tyler (Product Ops): Awesome. After deploy, priority tasks: post-deploy smoke (Jamie), docs publish (Priya), and customer comms (Maya). Marking owners. :thumbsup:
